title: Pricing
description: {price} per full user and {teamPrice} per team member, per month. CRM, planning, timesheets, invoicing and margins included. Prices exclude VAT.
teaser: {price} per full user, {teamPrice} per team member.
lead: Full users sell, plan, approve and invoice. Team members log their time and get the signals meant for them. Both get every module; nothing is sold as an add-on.

plan.unit: per person per month, excl. VAT

seats.name: Full user
seats.text: Sales, planning, delivery leads, finance and management: everything their role allows.

seats.name: Team member
seats.text: My Space, time and leave, the projects and tasks they work on, and their own signals.

included: Timesheets with manager and client approval
Client portal and signals for every team
Setup, import from our templates, training per role and 30 days of support

example.text: A firm of {examplePeople} people, with {exampleFull} full users and {exampleTeam} team members, pays {exampleFull} × {price} + {exampleTeam} × {teamPrice} = **{exampleTotal} a month**. As a founding customer, it pays {exampleFounding} a month in its first year.

items.q: Who counts as a full user?
items.a: Anyone who sells, plans other people, approves time, or works in finance or admin. Everyone else is a team member.

items.q: Do we pay for people who only log time?
items.a: Yes, at the team member price of {teamPrice} a month. They log time and leave, see their own projects and get the signals meant for them.

items.q: How long is the contract, and can we cancel?

items.a: Monthly or yearly in advance, by [[invoice or direct debit]].

final.h2: Talk it through with your own numbers
final.text: {minutes} minutes with {founder}, including what Implesta would cost for your team.
